Subject: Discovery follow-up: proposing rotating demo slots across time zones

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Great to hear about FinTechCo's plans to standardize inference for your customer-facing chat features and the throughput targets you mentioned (peak 120 req/s, ~2k tokens per session). Per our conversation, next step is a technical deep-dive + demo where Aditya (solutions engineer) can walk through the model routing, batching, and quantization trade-offs.

To make scheduling fair for your EU/APAC teammates, we propose a rotating demo cadence: alternate demo times between US-friendly and EU/APAC-friendly windows so no single region is always on late nights. Below are 3 proposed slots for next week — please mark your availability or suggest alternatives:

- Option A (US-friendly): Tue 2026-07-28 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 BST
- Option B (EU-friendly): Wed 2026-07-29 14:00 BST / 15:00 CEST / 06:00 PT
- Option C (APAC-friendly): Thu 2026-07-30 09:00 SG/HKT / 01:00 BST / 18:00 PT (this is early for US)

Attached is a short demo agenda and checklist for any network/security items Aditya will want access to. If you prefer, here’s my Calendly to pick a time that works for the team: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/technical-demo

Suggested attendees: Sara, Tom, one of your infra/ops leads (for firewall/KMS questions), Aditya (SE), Camila (AE) and me.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page)
